more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
No current country-wide food-use ban was confirmed in the regulatory sources checked in 2026.
The permissions checked in 2026 apply only to the specified preparations, food uses and conditions.
more_info.overview: Dimethyl dicarbonate is a reactive liquid used during beverage manufacture; it decomposes in water after treatment. Its preservative role is to limit spoilage caused by microorganisms and extend the storage life of the food. The specified material is supplied as colourless liquid. EU permissions include flavoured drinks, other, wine and other products defined in annex vii part ii of regulation (eu) no 1308/2013, cider and perry.
more_info.uses:
Examples in the EU food-use list include certain flavoured drinks; other; wine and other products defined in Part II of Annex VII to Regulation No 1308/2013.
The entries apply to particular food categories and may limit the amount, the preparation or the way it is used; they do not show how often the additive appears in retail products.
more_info.side_effects:
EFSA found no indication of concern at reported beverage-use levels in 2015. The additive rapidly reacts or breaks down before consumption.
The reaction products were assessed, but data were insufficient for an ADI.
